limits: Static trigger-policy checks, not a GitHub event replay.
GitHub currently documents a 3,000-file path-filter limit; pre-release reusable calls remain unfiltered.
Broad native-source and shared-input matches intentionally run all three additional suites; this does not reduce native workload.

review.scope: Independent source review of supplied patch; no blocker found. Root executed checks. No hosted trigger replay or branch-protection enforcement is claimed.
knownLimits: Broad scripts/config globs intentionally schedule some unrelated native checks.
Static trigger tests do not emulate GitHub event generation or prove reusable-call semantics alone; root separately verified unchanged job bodies and release workflow.
